milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the sandstone stairs at the corridor entrance and face them. Target is the center of the 3 stairs at relative (5, 0, 5). Max distance 16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player is actually looking at the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a sandstone slab with a wooden pickaxe causes the slab item to drop into inventory. This confirms both that the block was broken AND that the correct tool was used (bare hands yield no drop). The player starts with 0 sandstone_slab in inventory, so any presence confirms mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the back of the corridor and face the chiseled red sandstone wall. Target is the center of the 3x3 decorative wall at relative (5, 1, 10). Max distance 16 and facing_tolerance 60 ensure the player is looking at the back wall.
